description: This file defines a test class 'KpiAPITest' for testing the 'KpiAPI' in the OrangeHRM performance API module. It includes multiple test methods that verify the create, update, get all, get one, and delete functionalities of the KPI API, utilizing data providers and mock services.

classes.name: KpiAPITest
classes.description: A test class for the KpiAPI, extending EndpointIntegrationTestCase, with methods to test create, update, retrieve, and delete operations using PHPUnit data providers and mock services.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of KPI entries via the API, using provided test case parameters.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the updating of KPI entries via the API.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single KPI entry.
